items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ali Mohammed Jackson is from that Jackson family.

ctx.x: Are they cousins? Because him and Carlos, seemed like they came to New York together or around the same time.
They came out -- they’re in the same generation. They -- but Ali Mohammed Jackson is from that Jackson family.
He’s playing with, the last time I saw him, with Dee Dee Bridgewater. One’s a trumpet player too. They got a trumpet.
